rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a gift or present, including one given at a wedding.

example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 lai5 mat6 hai6 bei2 nei5 ge3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday way to describe something current or belonging to the present time.

example.english: The present arrangements are not final yet.
example.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 ge3 on1 paai4 zung6 mei6 ding6

rows.note: Use 而家 for the current moment or period in ordinary spoken Cantonese.

example.english: I can’t talk on the phone at present.
example.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 m4 fong1 bin6 gong2 din6 waa2

rows.note: Use this for people who are physically present at a place, meeting, or event.

example.english: All the directors present at the meeting signed the document.
example.traditional: 會議嗰陣，所有董事都在場。
example.jyutping: wui6 ji5 go2 zan6 so2 jau5 dung2 si6 dou1 zoi6 coeng4

rows.note: Use this as the everyday choice when presenting an ordinary gift to someone, rather than an award or official honour.

example.english: I present you with a birthday gift.
example.traditional: 我送畀你一份生日禮物。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sung3 bei2 nei5 jat1 fan6 saang1 jat6 lai5 mat6

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for putting something forward so that people can see it.

example.english: We will present the new phone tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我哋聽日會展示新款手機。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 wui5 zin2 si6 san1 fun2 sau2 gei1

rows.note: Use this demonstrative pattern when “present” means the particular thing currently being referred to, with the appropriate classifier.

example.english: This present bill needs to be submitted right away.
example.jyutping: ne1 zoeng1 daan1 jiu3 zik1 hak1 gaau1

rows.note: Use this when putting an idea, matter, or proposal forward for consideration.

example.english: I want to present a proposal.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 tai4 ceot1 jat1 go3 fong1 on3

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for introducing a person, including in a formal setting.

example.english: Let me present my friend to you.
example.traditional: 等我介紹我個朋友畀你識。
example.jyutping: dang2 ngo5 gaai3 siu6 ngo5 go3 pang4 jau5 bei2 nei5 sik1
